data.credibility: Management generally delivers on concrete targets like FY26 revenue at 3.1% and hiring at 20,000. However, they demonstrate a pattern of lowering FY27 revenue guidance after initial promises, though operating margins and tax rate projections remain reliably on track.

lines.line: Promised 2% to 3% FY26 revenue growth; delivered 3.1%.
Promised 20% to 22% operating margin; actual FY26 reached 23.7%.
Targeted 20,000 fresh hires for FY26 and successfully delivered.
Plans to recruit 20,000 college graduates next year remain on track.
FY27 revenue guidance of 1.5% to 3.5% was lowered in subsequent quarters.
FY27 operating margin guidance of 20% to 22% remains on track.
Effective tax rate guidance of 29% to 30% for FY27 is on track.
Plan for 6,000 frontier engineers over the next few years stays on track.
Net new mega deal expected to add over 1% growth in FY28 is pending.

bull: High capital efficiency is evident with an ROE of 31.9% and ROCE of 40.0%, backed by a strong net worth of ₹99,077 cr.
Robust cash conversion: over five years, operating cash flow reached 110% of reported profit, supported by ₹43,075 crore in cash and investments.
The company maintains a nearly debt-free balance sheet with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09 against ₹8,525 cr in borrowings.
bear: Revenue growth is decelerating significantly, dropping to 6.8% annually over three years compared to 12.2% over five years.
EBITDA margins have compressed over time, falling from 27.8% in FY21 down to 23.7% in FY26.
FY27 revenue guidance has been lowered multiple times since its initial Q4 FY26 release, signaling ongoing top-line softness.
